Source   Edit  

Opt-in instrumentation for the IC backend, enabled with -d:icBNodeProf. Off, every template below is discard and nothing is linked in.

It lives in its own module with NO compiler imports so that any stage can use it without creating a cycle — ast2nif for the loader, nifbackend for the stage phases, cgen for what happens per routine.

Each backend process appends ONE line to $NIM_IC_BNODE_PROF at exit (or to stderr when that is unset), because a --ic:on build fans out a process per module per stage and interleaved writes would tear. Use -d:icNoParallel when the numbers need to be attributable to a particular module.

Counts are for volume, timings for cost, and the two answer different questions: a call count alone once pointed at the wrong accessor (700k calls worth 8ms) while the real cost was 259k info resolutions worth 1.36s.
